notes: v2: no_lastools on a stratified sample of England (groundiff.data.select: quarries, embankments and flood defences, marsh, coast, urban / suburban / village, woodland, upland, farmland, 25% of tiles with OpenStreetMap bridges). 15% of training tiles are centred on a bridge, and the flattened water under and next to bridges is kept in the target so the model learns to take decks out. Fine-tuned from runs/no_lastools/best.pt when it exists (lower learning rate, 12000 steps); tools/run_v2.sh runs the whole pipeline. v2 inputs also include tile_range (the tile's height range in metres) and wide-area context (ctx_*: 1 km around each tile at 4 m/px, read by the network's context branch; 'PrioStitch as an input'). run_v2.sh with FROM_SCRATCH=1 trains it from scratch (20000 steps).
